aparanna.cp: neut. leguminous seeds (such as peas) other than cereals.

C: aparaṇṇa：n. [apara-aṇṇa（後-食物）＜anna] 後食（調製好的或煮過的穀類或豆穀食品），穀物，其他種類的穀類或豆穀食品.
aparanna：[nt.] leguminous seeds （such as peas） other than cereals.
B:
aparaṇṇa：aparaṇṇa（na）
အပရဏ္ဏ（န）
[apara+anna. nna- ṇṇa-pru.]
[အပရ+အန္န။ န္န-ကို ဏ္ဏ-ပြု။]
P: Aparaṇṇa，（nt.） [apara + aṇṇa = anna] “the other kind of cereal”，prepared or cooked cereals，pulse etc. Opp. to pubbaṇṇa the unprepared or raw corn （= āmakadhañña Vin.IV，265； Vin.III，151 （pubb° +）； IV，265，267； A.IV，108，112 （tila-mugga-māsā°； opp. sāli-yavaka etc.）； Nd<sup>2</sup> 314 （aparaṇṇaṁ nāma sūpeyyaṁ）； J.V，406 （°jā = hareṇukā，pea）； Miln.106 （pubbaṇṇa°）. See also dhañña & harita. （Page 52）
K:
aparaṇṇa：＂အပရဏ္ဏ（န）
[အပရ+အန္န။ န္န-ကို ဏ္ဏ-ပြု။]
နောက်၌ဖြစ်သော-စားဖွယ်-အစာ၊ ကမ်ဘာဦးအခါဝယ် စပါးမျိုးတို့ ပေါ်ပြီးနောက် ပေါ်လာသော ပဲနောက်，ပဲကြီးစသော ပဲမျိုး။

aparanta.p: [Apara+anta] (pu) CL=9 (1) the future portion. Future aggregates, bases and element. (2) next edge. (3) another- other edge/ end. Aparanta (masc.) [apara+ anta. See Vācappati.] (1) The Aparanta country. (mfn) (2) dwellors of Aparanta country.

aparaṇṇa.p: [Apara+anna] (na) Google Translate နန် - ကွန် နါ - ပြု. Beans, such as lentils and lentils, appeared after the advent of rice at the beginning of the world.
pn:
Aparaṇṇa, Aparaṇṇagijjha. A vulture who lived in Gijjhapabbata.

He had a son Migālopa, strong and mighty, able to fly higher than his fellows. In spite of his father’s warning, he flew too high and was dashed to pieces by the Verambha winds.

The Bodhisatta is identified with Aparaṇṇa. Ja.iii.255-6.
